qualification.title: Cambridge OCR Level 3 Alternative Academic Qualification Cambridge Advanced National in Applied Science (Extended Certificate)

school_route.source_note: School prospectus 2026/27 Applied Science course checked on 25 November 2026; lists F180/F181 exams and F182/F185/F183 coursework.

F180.title: Fundamentals of science
F180.assessment: mandatory external exam for H051 and H151
F180.spec_points: B1-B4, C1-C4, P1-P3; practical teaching references 1-6 are included in the relevant discipline topic areas
F180.data_formula_booklet: Use the matching official F180 Data, Formulae and Relationships Booklet. Version 8.0 updated the mass-attenuation density unit to g cm-3 (specification section 5.2.1, page 55; update recorded on page 4).

F181.title: Science in society
F181.assessment: mandatory external exam for H151 only
F181.content_scope: All four topic areas; at least one question or part from each topic area. Scientific literacy, data interpretation, How Science Works and mathematical skills are cross-linked.

content_treatment.F180: Official unit learning points are maintained by discipline (Biology, Chemistry, Physics); written practical questions remain eligible for F180 scored practice and retain their official practical point under its discipline topic area.
content_treatment.F181: Distinct scientific-literacy and data-handling point codes; no generic A-level science tags.
content_treatment.F182_to_F186: Qualification and unit references only. Assignment samples are not attemptable scored questions.
